examName: Assistant Professor (Mathematics) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-A and Lecturer (Mathematics) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-B (Collegiate Branch) - Syllabus
examNameMr: सहाय्यक प्राध्यापक (गणित) महाराष्ट्र शिक्षण सेवा, गट-अ आणि व्याख्याता (गणित) महाराष्ट्र शिक्षण सेवा, गट-ब (महाविद्यालयीन शाखा) - अभ्यासक्रम
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Elementary set theory, countable and uncountable sets, real number system as a complete ordered field, Archimedean property, supremum, infimum
Sequences and series, convergence, limsup, liminf
Bolzano Weierstrass theorem, Heine Borel theorem
Uniform continuity, differentiability, mean value theorem, Riemann integral
Sequences and series of functions, uniform convergence
Functions of several variables, directional derivative, partial derivative, derivative as a linear transformation, inverse and implicit function theorem
Lebesgue measure, Lebesgue measurable function, Lebesgue integration
Monotonic functions, functions of bounded variations, absolutely continuous functions
Metric spaces, compactness, connectedness, normed linear spaces, spaces of continuous functions as examples
Algebra of complex numbers, the complex plane
Power series, transcendental functions as exponential, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions
Analytic functions, Cauchy-Riemann equations
Conformal mappings, Mobius transformations
Contour integral, Cauchy's theorem, Cauchy's integral formula
Liouville's theorem, Maximum modulus principle, Schwarz lemma, Open mapping theorem
Taylor series, Laurent series, calculus of residues
Permutations, combinations, pigeon-hole principle, inclusion-exclusion principle, derangements
Fundamental theorem of arithmetic, divisibility in Z, congruences, Chinese remainder theorem, Euler's phi function, primitive roots
Groups, subgroups, normal subgroups, quotient groups, homomorphisms
Cyclic groups, permutation groups, Cayley's theorem, class equations, Sylow theorem
Rings, ideals, prime and maximal ideals, quotient rings
Unique factorization domain, principal ideal domain, Euclidean domain, polynomial rings and irreducibility criteria
Fields, finite fields, field extensions, algebraic extensions, splitting fields, separable extensions, Galois groups, solvable by radicals
Topological spaces, basis for topology, product topology, subspace topology, closed sets and limit points, continuous functions, quotient topology
Connectedness and compactness, countability axioms, separation axioms

Introduction to probability, probability space, events, sigma fields, sigma field of borel sets, limit superior and limit inferior for a sequence of events, probability measure, conditional probability, Bayes formula

Random variables, discrete and absolutely continuous random variables, Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson and normal distributions, expectation and variance of random variables both discrete and absolutely continuous
Characteristic functions, Chebyshev inequality, weak law of large numbers, convergence of random variables, Kolmogorov strong law of large numbers, central limit theorem

units.unitTitle: Ordinary Differential Equations, Partial Differential Equations, Calculus of Variations and Classical Mechanics
units.unitTitleMr: सामान्य अवकल समीकरणे, आंशिक अवकल समीकरणे, कॅल्क्युलस ऑफ व्हेरिएशन्स आणि क्लासिकल मेकॅनिक्स
topics: Existence and uniqueness of solutions to initial value problem of first order ordinary differential equations (ODE), system of first order linear ODE with constant coefficient and variable coefficients
Linear dependence and independence of solution of homogenous n-th order linear ODE, Wronskian matrix, Lagrange's method (variation of parameters)
Sturm-Liouville separation and comparison theorems, oscillation properties of solutions, eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of Sturm-Liouville boundary value problem
Lagrange and Charpit methods for solving first order Partial Differential Equations (PDE), Cauchy's problem for first order PDEs
Classification of second order PDEs, general solution of higher order PDEs with constant coefficients, method of separation of variables for Laplace, heat and wave equations
The variation of a functional, Euler-Lagrange equation, necessary and sufficient conditions for extrema, the case of several variables, simple variable end point problem
Variational problems with subsidiary conditions, variational methods for boundary value problems in ordinary and partial differential equations
Generalized coordinates, Lagrange's equations, Hamilton's canonical equations, Hamilton's principle and principle of least action
Two dimensional motion of rigid bodies, Euler's dynamical equations for the motion of a rigid body about an axis, theory of small oscillations

units.unitTitle: Linear Algebra, Linear Integral Equations and Numerical Analysis
units.unitTitleMr: रेषीय बीजगणित, रेषीय समाकल समीकरणे आणि संख्यात्मक विश्लेषण
topics: Vector spaces over a field F, subspaces, basis and dimensions, linear transformations, rank and nullity of a linear transformation
Matrix associated with a linear transformation, rank of a matrix and its equivalence to rank of linear transformation, determinant of matrices, linear equations
Characteristic polynomial, annihilating polynomial, Cayley-Hamilton theorem, minimal polynomial, eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Invariant subspaces, diagonalization, triangularization, Jordan canonical form
Inner product spaces, orthonormal basis
Quadratic forms, reduction and classification of quadratic forms
Linear integral equation of the first and second kind of Fredholm and Volterra type, solutions with separable kernels, characteristic numbers and eigenfunctions, resolvent kernel
Types of integral equations: initial value problems, boundary value problems, singular integral equations, Abel integral equations
Numerical solutions of algebraic equations, method of iterations and Newton-Raphson method, rate of convergence
Solution of a system of linear algebraic equations using Gauss elimination and Gauss-Seidel methods
Finite differences, Lagrange, Hermite and spline interpolation
Numerical differentiation and integration
Numerical solutions of ODEs using Picard, Euler, modified Euler and Runge-Kutta methods
